'''Zohra ben Lakhdar Akrout''' ({{Langx|ar|زهرة بن لخضر عكروت}}; born 12 March 1943) is a Tunisian [[Spectroscopy|spectroscopist]] specializing in developing new spectroscopic methods to study the influence of pollutants on the quality of air, water, and plants''.''<ref>{{cite web|title = Scientists with Vision: Professor Zohra Ben Lakhdar|url = http://www.wipo.int/wipo_magazine/en/2005/06/article_0007.html|website = www.wipo.int|access-date = 2015-11-17|date = November 2005}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|title = Dr Zohra BEN LAKHDAR, physicienne à l'honneur à Paris|url = https://www.babnet.net/cadredetail-2328.asp|website = Babnet Tunisie|access-date = 2015-11-17|date = 5 March 2005|language = fr}}</ref><ref name="My Hero">{{cite web|title = The My Hero Project – Zohra Ben Lakhdar|url = https://myhero.com/hero.asp?hero=LAKHDAR|website = myhero.com|access-date = 2015-11-18}}</ref> She earned in 2005 the [[L'Oréal-UNESCO Awards for Women in Science|L’Oréal-UNESCO Awards for Women in Science]].

== Career ==
Ben Lakhdar graduated in 1968 from [[Pierre and Marie Curie University]].<ref name=":1">{{cite web|title = BEN LAKHDAR – AKROUT, Zohra|url = https://www.if.ufrgs.br/iupap/tunisia-cv2.html|website = www.if.ufrgs.br|access-date = 2015-11-17}}</ref> She earned her PhD from the same university in 1978 with a thesis entitled "Application à l'étude de la raie 4047Å de mercure de la méthode à balayage magnétique" (study of the line shape of 4047Å mercury line using a tunable magnetic field).<ref name=":1" /><ref name=":0">{{cite journal|title = Following the Light: Opening Doors to Science in Tunisia|journal = Science|date = 2005-12-02|issn = 0036-8075|pmid = 16322441|pages = 1435–1437|volume = 310|issue = 5753|doi = 10.1126/science.1115181|first = Zohra Ben|last = Lakhdar|doi-access = | s2cid=29636555 }}</ref> She went back to Tunisia to become professor in 1982 at the [[Tunis University]] and served as director of the Laboratory of Atomic Molecular Spectroscopy and Applications (LSAMA).<ref>{{cite web|title = LSAMA-FST|url = http://www.lsama-fst.tn/|website = Laboratoire de Spectroscopie Atomique Moléculaire et Applications|access-date = 2015-11-17|language = fr|archive-date = 2016-03-04|archive-url = https://web.archive.org/web/20160304084310/http://www.lsama-fst.tn/|url-status = dead}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|title = Zohra Ben Lakhdar|url = http://www.thinkers-doers.com/en/speakers/zohra-ben-lakhdar-2/|website = Thinkers & doers|access-date = 2015-11-17|archive-date = 2016-03-04|archive-url = https://web.archive.org/web/20160304064945/http://www.thinkers-doers.com/en/speakers/zohra-ben-lakhdar-2/|url-status = dead}}</ref> She was a founding member of the Tunisian Physics Society and a founding member of the Tunisian Astronomy Society.<ref>{{cite web|title = Prof. Zohra Ben Lakhdar|url = http://www.iasworld.org/prof-zohra-ben-lakhdar/|website = www.iasworld.org|access-date = 2015-11-17|archive-date = 2015-11-21|archive-url = https://web.archive.org/web/20151121041057/http://www.iasworld.org/prof-zohra-ben-lakhdar/|url-status = dead}}</ref>

== Honours ==
She was elected in 1992 to the [[Islamic World Academy of Sciences]].<ref>{{cite web|title = IAS » Prof. Zohra Ben Lakhdar|url = http://www.iasworld.org/prof-zohra-ben-lakhdar/|website = www.iasworld.org|access-date = 2015-11-17|archive-date = 2015-11-21|archive-url = https://web.archive.org/web/20151121041057/http://www.iasworld.org/prof-zohra-ben-lakhdar/|url-status = dead}}</ref> She is a fellow of the [[African Academy of Sciences|African Academy of Science]] since 2006.<ref>{{cite web|title = Ben Lakhdar-Arkout, Zohra, Prof.|url = http://www.aasciences.org/index.php/tunisia/172-ben-lakhdar-arkout-zohra-prof|website = www.aasciences.org|access-date = 2015-11-17}}</ref> She became senior associate member at the [[International Centre for Theoretical Physics|Abdus Salam International Centre for Theoretical Physics]] (ICTP). She earned in 2005 the [[L'Oréal-UNESCO Awards for Women in Science|L’Oréal-UNESCO Awards for Women in Science]] for ''"experiments and models in [[infrared spectroscopy]] and its applications to pollution, detection and medicine".''<ref name=":0" /><ref>{{cite web|url = https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9PfgCBaMAa4|access-date = 2015-11-17|title = Prof. Zohra Ben Lakhdar, 2005 For Women In Science Laureate for Africa (Tunisia)| website=[[YouTube]] }}</ref> She was identified as a Science hero by [[The My Hero Project]].<ref name="My Hero" />
